Generate a multiple-choice question with exactly 4 answer options (A, B, C, D) where only one option is correct. Return a single valid JSON object with the following fields: - "questionText": string, the full question - "options": array of 4 objects each with "id" (A/B/C/D) and "text" (the answer choice) - "correctAnswer": string, the single option id that is correct (e.g. "B") - "explanation": string, 2-3 sentences explaining why the correct answer is correct and why the others are wrong
Example output: { "questionText": "What is the governor limit for SOQL queries in a single transaction?", "options": [ {"id": "A", "text": "50"}, {"id": "B", "text": "100"}, {"id": "C", "text": "150"}, {"id": "D", "text": "200"} ], "correctAnswer": "B", "explanation": "Salesforce enforces a limit of 100 SOQL queries per synchronous transaction. This prevents excessive database calls and encourages bulkification. Options A, C and D are not the correct governor limit." }
